svg.title: deepseek-one-gpu architecture
svg.desc: Attention and dense layers run on the GPU. The router sends each token to 6 of 384 experts per layer. Experts in the VRAM hot set (5,825 of 15,360, 69.5 GiB) run on the GPU; the others (9,535, 113.9 GiB in pinned RAM) run on CPU threads at the same time, and their rows go back to the GPU to be combined. Experts swap between RAM and VRAM over PCIe as the traffic changes.
svg.text: Where each part of the model runs, for every generated token
The placement of the published runs: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GB) and AMD EPYC host, 8 batch slots
69.5 GiB, the most used of the 15,360 experts
AMD EPYC CPU and pinned RAM, bound to the GPU's NUMA node
113.9 GiB, every expert not in VRAM
misses: the expert is in RAM
Each layer's router picks 6 of its 384 experts for every token (40 layers). In the measured runs about 9 of 10 picks
were already in VRAM (hit rate 0.895 over 470 requests, 2026-10-13). The hot set follows the traffic: experts swap in and out.
